title: Raw-active common-cell nine-level P&V canary
hypothesis: The public raw-active cell characterization path can sample the exact assignment-84001 population, exclude the AIHWKit reference, condition cells at the RESET boundary, and execute all nine common targets without a non-finite endpoint or incomplete artifact.
motivation: This is an operational gate for the new array-wide common-baseline and common-increment cell-level P&V experiment. It is not evidence about nine-state yield, QAT accuracy, or on-chip training.

arms.description: Eight development identities, one repeat, and all nine targets through the raw-active one-pulse plant.

completion_criteria: Use assignment 84001, the repaired 158,800-cell binding layout, the frozen inward-rounded nine-target codebook, and the one-pulse cap-128 controller.
Persist the complete population, selection, codebook/support audit, streamed trajectories and verify events, integrity report, analysis, report, and plot.
Record reference_consumed=false and retain exact support, apparent acceptance, and persistent endpoint facts separately.
Complete all 72 declared smoke trajectories with no non-finite endpoint. No scientific success threshold is attached.
analysis_plan: Verify the exact assignment-84001 population fingerprint and 90-percent all-nine support audit.
Verify target, seed, conditioning, controller, event, and terminal trajectory coverage.
Use the result only as authorization to launch the predeclared production characterization.
